fullPassage: Over time, certain biological and behavioral features of humans stop serving a purpose. Instead of disappearing completely, they remain intact but have no function. This is what happened with the grasp reflex. If you place an object in an infant's hand, he or she will automatically grab it. This reflex was helpful for our distant ancestors, whose babies had to hold tightly to their mothers' fur. But the grasp reflex is of little use to human babies now, as they don't have to cling for survival. Another unnecessary feature we inherited from our ancestors is goose bumps. Goose bumps occur when we are cold or frightened and the hairs on our body stand straight up. Today, they are anything but useful. But they kept our hairy ancestors warm because the erect hairs prevented body heat from escaping. They also made our ancestors appear larger, helping them scare away predators.

① adult: 어른 — 아기와 반대
② infant: 유아 — 아기나 아주 어린 아이 ←정답
③ parent: 부모 — 정의와 무관
④ elder: 연장자 — 반대
det.tip: 아기나 아주 어린 아이 = infant(유아)

questions.passage: Over time, certain biological and behavioral features of humans stop serving a purpose. Instead of __________ (disappear) completely, they remain intact but have no function.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로)

det.korean: disappear(사라지다) → disappearing. 전치사 of 뒤에는 동명사(-ing)
det.analysis: 전치사 'of' 뒤에는 명사나 동명사(-ing)가 와야 해요. 그래서 동사 disappear를 동명사 disappearing으로 바꿔야 해요. 'Instead of disappearing completely'는 '완전히 사라지는 대신에'라는 뜻이에요.
det.tip: 전치사(of) 뒤 → 동명사 -ing → disappearing

questions.passage: But they kept our hairy ancestors warm because the erect hairs prevented body heat from escaping. They also made our ancestors appear __________ (large), helping them scare away predators.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로)

det.korean: large(큰) → larger. '더 커 보이다'라는 비교의 뜻이므로 비교급(-er)
det.analysis: 여기서는 조상들을 실제보다 '더 크게' 보이게 했다는 비교의 뜻이에요. 그래서 형용사 large에 -er을 붙여 비교급 larger로 바꿔야 해요. 'appear larger'는 '더 커 보이다'라는 뜻이에요.
det.tip: '더 ~한'은 형용사 + -er (비교급) → larger

questions.passage: Over time, certain biological and behavioral features of humans stop serving a purpose. Instead of disappearing completely, they remain intact but have no function. This is what happened with the grasp reflex. If you place an object in an infant's hand, he or she will automatically grab it. This reflex was helpful for our distant ancestors, whose babies had to hold tightly to their mothers' fur. But the grasp reflex is of little use to human babies now, as they don't have to cling for survival. Another unnecessary feature we inherited from our ancestors is goose bumps. Goose bumps occur when we are cold or frightened and the hairs on our body stand straight up. Today, they are __________ useful. But they kept our hairy ancestors warm because the erect hairs prevented body heat from escaping. They also made our ancestors appear larger, helping them scare away predators.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: nothing but=오직 ~일 뿐 / more than=~ 이상 / rather than=~보다는 / anything but=결코 ~이 아닌
det.analysis:
① nothing but: '오직 유용할 뿐'? 오늘날 소름은 기능이 없으므로 반대
② more than: '유용함 이상'? 문맥과 반대
③ rather than: '유용하기보다는' — 뒤 구조와 안 맞음
④ anything but: 오늘날 소름은 '결코 유용하지 않다'(기능 없음). 뒤의 But으로 과거의 쓸모와 대비 ←정답
det.tip: anything but useful = 결코 유용하지 않은 (오늘날 소름은 기능이 없음)

questions.passage: Over time, certain biological and behavioral features of humans stop serving a purpose. Instead of disappearing completely, they remain intact but have no function. This is what happened with the grasp reflex. If you place an object in an infant's hand, he or she will automatically grab it. This reflex was helpful for our distant ancestors, whose babies had to hold tightly to their mothers' fur. But the grasp reflex is __________ to human babies now, as they don't have to cling for survival. Another unnecessary feature we inherited from our ancestors is goose bumps. Goose bumps occur when we are cold or frightened and the hairs on our body stand straight up. Today, they are anything but useful. questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: of little use=거의 쓸모없는 / of great value=매우 가치 있는 / in high demand=수요가 많은 / at serious risk=심각한 위험에 처한
det.analysis:
① of little use: 요즘 아기들은 생존을 위해 매달릴 필요가 없으므로 파악 반사는 '거의 쓸모없다' ←정답
② of great value: '매우 가치 있는'? 필요 없어졌다는 문맥과 반대
③ in high demand: '수요가 많은'? 문맥 무관
④ at serious risk: '심각한 위험에 처한'? 문맥 무관
det.tip: 매달릴 필요 없음 → 파악 반사는 '거의 쓸모없는'(of little use)
